summary.motive: Exploit defenses over-pursuing Stefanski's heavy pin-and-pull run flow by rolling the quarterback naked to the opposite boundary with a 3-level flood/slide concept.
summary.whyItWorks: The aggressive sweep action pulls all 7 front-seven defenders flowing horizontally right. When the quarterback rolls naked left, there are literally zero defensive players left in the weakside flat.
summary.failureMode: A disciplined backside edge defender who stays home for bootleg contain, forcing the QB to throw away or take a sack.

beats.title: Heavy Frontside Run Illusion
beats.text: Offense shows identical 13-personnel condensed wing alignment, executing full lateral sweep steps to the right at the snap.

beats.title: The Front Seven Flow & Backside Vacuum
beats.text: The entire defensive front seven bites aggressively on the right sweep. Backside WDE crashes hard inside, completely giving up backside contain.

beats.title: The Naked Bootleg Rollout
beats.text: QB executes a pristine bootleg fake, pulls the ball cleanly, and rolls naked back to the left into 20 yards of empty green grass.

beats.title: The Slide Strike in Wide Open Space
beats.text: Backside inline TE U slips underneath the crashed edge on the Slide route, catching a crisp strike on the run from QB for a 14-yard first down.

relations.tell: QB keeps ball around backside edge naked; backside TE (U) releases into weakside flat.
